semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Seisen specializes in gas filtration solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Nippon Seisen Co., Ltd. produces all-metal gas filters and purification systems essential for the semiconductor, LCD, LED, and solar manufacturing industries. Their flagship product, the NASclean gas filter, effectively removes particles down to 0.0025 microns, ensuring high purity in process gases.
capabilities: All-metal gas filters for semiconductor manufacturing
High-flow filters for bulk gas filtration
